basic_info.description: ALERT - Price Drop $688,888   Exceptional Value! Top Floor South Exposure Priced to Sell Fast!  Step into this bright and welcoming top-floor 2-bed, 2-bath open-concept condo, perfectly positioned for optimal natural light with its south exposure. Priced below the last sale, this condo is sure to sell quickly. The unit features updated stainless steel appliances in the kitchen and new flooring in the living areas, with plush carpeting in the bedrooms. The primary bedroom offers a spacious walk-in closet with custom cabinetry, an ensuite bathroom, and access to a private balcony. The guest bedroom includes two closets. Additional conveniences include in-unit laundry and a large parking space close to the elevator.    Modern amenities enhance your living experience, including the Butterfly access control system and on-site ParcelPending lockers for secure package management. Dining and shopping are easy with HMart, Paris Baguette, Daeho, 7Leaves, XTreme Pizza, and other eateries and retail outlets directly downstairs. The nearby Stonestown Galleria, with two large grocery chains, Target, and over 25 eateries, has turned this neighborhood into a true foodie destination.    Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity! Schedule your tour today
